reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Yuja Niacin Anti Blemish Serum 50ml
reviews.text: Отличный серум против высыпаний, результат пришел после месяца использования, ничего до этого не помогало! Быстро впитывается, единственный минус быстро заканчивается
reviews.zh: 出色嘅抗痘精華，用咗一個月先見到效果，之前咩都冇用！吸收得好快，唯一嘅缺點就係用得好快。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Yuja Niacin Anti Blemish Serum 50ml
reviews.text: I use it every day, but only once a day, and I felt that my skin has improved my acne scar a little bit for a month.
reviews.zh: 我每日都用，但每日只搽一次，用咗一個月，覺得暗瘡印有少少改善。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Yuja Niacin Anti Blemish Serum 50ml
reviews.text: I use it in combination with VT needle shot 100 daily. I like the fresh citrus smell, but could not see the benefits of les irritations yet. Sunscreen after is a must!
reviews.zh: 我每日同 VT needle shot 100 一起用。鍾意佢清新嘅柑橘味，但暫時未見到有減低刺激嘅效果。之後一定要搽防曬！

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Yuja Niacin Anti Blemish Serum 50ml
reviews.text: My skin looks glowy. It brightens the skin tone and fade my dark sport. Fall in love with it. Make my skin brighter. Now, it’s brighter than my future 😭
reviews.zh: 皮膚望落有水光感。提亮咗膚色，亦淡咗我嘅色斑。愛上咗佢，皮膚變得更亮白，仲亮過我嘅未來😭

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Yuja Niacin Anti Blemish Serum 50ml
reviews.text: Love this serum because it smells amazing and is nice on the skin. Seen a little brightening progress but overall not too much. It's fairly fast absorbing and not too sticky.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢支精華，聞落好香，搽上皮膚都好舒服。見到有少少提亮效果，但整體唔算好明顯。吸收都幾快，而且唔會黐笠。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Yuja Niacin Anti Blemish Serum 50ml
reviews.text: I had a sample of this and really saw a reduction of redness. I have to keep using to see how long the results last. So far, it has been doing a good job.
reviews.zh: 我用過 sample，真係見到泛紅有減少。要繼續用先睇到效果可以維持幾耐。到目前為止，表現唔錯。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Yuja Niacin Anti Blemish Serum 50ml
reviews.text: I didn’t expect to like this product but it makes wondrs to my oily skin. My acne scars are looking better and in the morning wake up with great healthy skin
reviews.zh: 本來冇諗過會鍾意呢件產品，但用喺我塊油性肌上面真係有神奇效果。暗瘡印望落好咗，第二朝起身皮膚健康又有光澤。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Yuja Niacin Anti Blemish Serum 50ml
reviews.text: I like the smell and how light it is. I've been layering it with other serums and it doesn't make my face feel weighed down. Absorbs fairly quickly
reviews.zh: 鍾意佢嘅味道同輕盈嘅質感。我會同其他精華一齊疊用，塊面唔會覺得厚重。吸收都幾快。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
